confidence: Documented-specimen mapping; manufacturer-backed calibre specifications, not an exact-reference factory technical sheet
notes: Do not confuse A32360 with Colt GMT A32350 or Colt GMT+ A32370. Check the separately engraved limited-edition number against the case, dial and papers: Christie's records an A32360 numbered 098/100. Date at 3 and a red arrow GMT hand are documented on a blue-dial specimen. The base reference does not establish dial colour, Wempe status or the total across all editions. Dealer specimens report a unidirectional bezel, screw-down crown, sapphire and 1000 m rating; no present water-resistance claim. Case measurements differ between listings (41/42 mm), so no rejection threshold is set. A calibre marking or matching serial alone does not authenticate the watch.

technicalDetail.movement: Breitling's official calibre 32 specification: self-winding mechanical with 24-hour second time zone, approximately 42 hours reserve, 28,800 vph and 21 jewels. These are calibre-level specifications; the source's Avenger case dimensions and water rating do not apply to A32360. Compare architecture, finishing and functional GMT operation as well as markings.
technicalDetail.dating: A dealer describes an A32360B4/C698 with case date stamp 2005. This documents one example, not a start/end production range. Serial 740203 was not independently matched to a factory record; no year, originality or counterfeit verdict is assigned. Do not use pre-1980 serial charts for this model.
technicalDetail.edition: Limited-edition number (such as 098/100) is distinct from the individual serial. Record both when present. Published dial/edition claims conflict; confirm the actual execution using matching papers and manufacturer support.
technicalDetail.images: A sourced white-dial A32360 specimen photograph is included. No reliable opened A32360/Breitling 32 movement photograph was verified in this research; no substitute movement image is presented as this calibre.
